packageRules.description: Runtime dependencies end up in dist/. The pull request stays red until someone runs 'bun run build' on the branch and commits the result, so these never merge on their own.
prBodyNotes: This changes the bundled action. Check out the branch, run `bun run build` and commit `dist/`.

packageRules.description: The Bun version decides the bytes of dist/, so a bump needs a rebuild too.
prBodyNotes: A new Bun version can change the bundle. Check out the branch, run `bun run build` and commit `dist/` if it changed.
